mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Overcast skies cover the area near Verona City Hall with a temperature of 34 degrees that feels like 24, along with a full moon tonight. The International Space Station will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15th. Payments may be made in two installments, with the first due January 31st to the City Treasurer and the second due July 31st to the Dane County Treasurer. Payments can be submitted by mail, online, at City Hall, or via the twenty-four seven drop boxes.

Today features drop-in yoga classes at Insight Wellness Verona. Looking ahead to tomorrow, local evening events include Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's.

In police news, on Wednesday, November 11th, officers responded to Whalen Road and South Main Street where a woman was flagging down drivers asking for 911 to be called, leading to her arrest for bail jumping.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM tonight. Today's flavor of the day is Butter Pecan, so be sure to stop by before closing.
